assumptions.statement: Exact official competition/site/key-area polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No submitted boundary or key-area geometry may be represented as the official competition boundary, statutory redline, or exact project area.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional geometry is only for generation, visualization, and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: It is a provisional constraint and cannot support formal area scoring, parcel control, approval, or implementation claims.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap may be used as background-only context with ODbL attribution, not as official boundary or control evidence.
assumptions.impact: Any OSM-derived context must remain visually and analytically separate from official or professionally confirmed controls.

assumptions.statement: District-wide indicators in the 2017–2035 Haidian District Plan are directional references, not project measured targets.
assumptions.impact: They may frame upper-level direction but cannot be copied into project metrics or claimed as measured project performance.

assumptions.statement: Rail crossings, underground space, large structures, and precise road, redline, utility, or property claims require professional/official follow-up.
assumptions.impact: All such content must remain conceptual and cannot be treated as engineering feasibility, statutory control, ownership, or implementation evidence.

assumptions.statement: All precision-sensitive geometry, metrics, and figures must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.impact: Current spatial quantities and derived graphics are provisional and must not be carried forward without coordinate-system, topology, and area recalculation.
